_about: Public-domain H. R. Mackintosh (Hugh Ross Mackintosh, 1870-1936, New College, Edinburgh) for the Word Hoard, held to printings dated before 1930: Life on God's Plan (1909), The Person of Jesus Christ (1912), The Doctrine of the Person of Jesus Christ (1912), Studies in Christian Truth (catalogued 1914), Immortality and the Future (1915), Who is Jesus Christ? (1917), The Originality of the Christian Message (1920), The Divine Initiative (1921), Some Aspects of Christian Belief (catalogued 1923), The Christian Experience of Forgiveness (1927) and The Christian Apprehension of God (1929), raw Internet Archive OCR. His translations and edited volumes are alternates. Not C. H. Mackintosh. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 19 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

hrm-life-on-gods-plan: Life on God's Plan, sermons (London: Hodder and Stoughton, MCMIX)
hrm-person-of-jesus-christ: The Person of Jesus Christ (London: Student Christian Movement, 1912)
hrm-doctrine-of-person: The Doctrine of the Person of Jesus Christ, International Theological Library (New York: Charles Scribner's Sons, 1912)
hrm-studies-christian-truth: Studies in Christian Truth, second edition (London: Student Christian Movement; no year on title page, catalogued 1914)
hrm-immortality: Immortality and the Future: The Christian Doctrine of Eternal Life (London: Hodder and Stoughton, printed in 1915)
hrm-who-is-jesus: Who is Jesus Christ? The Church and the War, Tracts for To-Day no. 15 (Edinburgh: United Free Church of Scotland, MCMXVII)
hrm-originality: The Originality of the Christian Message (New York: Scribner, first published 1920)
hrm-divine-initiative: The Divine Initiative (London: Student Christian Movement, first published October 1921)
hrm-aspects-belief: Some Aspects of Christian Belief (New York: George H. Doran; no year on title page, catalogued 1923)
hrm-forgiveness: The Christian Experience of Forgiveness (New York and London: Harper & Brothers, copyright 1927, first edition)
hrm-apprehension-of-god: The Christian Apprehension of God, the James Sprunt Lectures (London: Student Christian Movement, first published September 1929)

_alternates.hrm-translations: Ritschl's Christian Doctrine of Justification and Reconciliation, translation edited with A. B. Macaulay (1900, 1902); Wendland's Miracles and Christianity, translated (c. 1911); Selections from the Literature of Theism, with Caldecott (1904)
_alternates.hrm-copies: Second copies of The Doctrine of the Person (1912-1920 impressions), Immortality (1917), Originality (1920), Divine Initiative (1921), Apprehension of God (Harper)
